item.title: Planning a kitchen renovation in the GTA: 8 questions to answer first
item.description: Before you pick a single tile, answer these eight questions. They decide your budget, your timeline and how much you will love the finished kitchen.

item.description: A small deposit, then payments tied to finished stages. Here is why that simple structure protects you, and what to look for in a quote.
